title: Baked Irish Beetroot Cake
description: A delightful Irish-inspired dessert made with beetroot, perfect for springtime. Moist and flavorful, this cake is a great way to enjoy the natural sweetness of beets.
instructions: Grease a 20cm (8 inch) round cake pan and set aside.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and a pinch of salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together beetroot, softened butter, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool in the pan for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
